brief.style: 128 BPM instrumental progressive tech house in F minor, 4/4. Instrumental drum machine and hardware synth ensemble. Short metallic FM pluck, snappy syncopated two-bar motif, sharp attack and gaps. Hard dry quarter-note kick, round analog bass alternating with the kick, bright offbeat hat, dry clap. The first full statement comes early. Variation shifts the last notes. Middle breakdown with no kick or sub and only the exposed filtered FM synth motif. Build with chopped pluck answers and denser closed hats. Return the same melody with brighter octave synth stabs, closed-to-open hats, full kick and elastic bass. Return to F and stop the drums for a clean natural synth tail.
